title: StockGPT
author: Unusual-Jelly-6037
selftext: Hi all! I was wondering if anyone's heard of/used [www.stockgpt.pro](http://www.stockgpt.pro) ... it seems to have come from nowhere, then all of a sudden it's all over Reddit. Some of the results though ... I've attached a couple screenshots of a couple of returns; some guy got 57% in 1 month with the number one ranked stock ($MU). $734 to $1150. Another screenshot showed a 17% increase from an 8 stock (diversified!) portfolio in 22 days. WTF! Is it time people start taking AI trading more seriously? Completely eradicates the need to spend countless hours looking at charts and reading 10-Q's, while also being more accurate. Pretty sure that StockGPT site also sends real time alerts if need to trim/buy more, etc. Will it get to a point where it gets targeted and banned by the FCA? It makes you wonder. Did some research and they seem to be a Delaware fintech LLC. 'Significant funding' as well (meaning over $1M), so isn't gonna be some low level bulls\*\*t. Very interesting.
